name: python-cli
description: Starter intent-graph for a Python command-line tool: target, argument parsing, command workflow, and an entrypoint artifact.

nodes.prompt: A command-line tool written in Python, installed as a console script.
nodes.label: Python CLI project

nodes.prompt: A CLI that accepts subcommands and flags, prints results to stdout, and uses exit codes to signal success or failure.
nodes.label: CLI tool target

nodes.prompt: Define the argument surface: the subcommands, their positional arguments and options, defaults, and help text. Invalid input exits non-zero with a clear message.
nodes.label: Argument parsing
rules: REQUIRE: invalid input exits with a non-zero status

nodes.prompt: Dispatch the parsed arguments to the matching subcommand handler, run it, and map its result to stdout plus an exit code.
nodes.label: Command dispatch workflow

nodes.prompt: Emit the __main__ entrypoint that builds the parser, parses sys.argv, dispatches, and exits with the returned status code.
nodes.label: __main__.py
